instructions.name: cancel_line
docs: Clears an approved commitment nobody drew. Admin only; refused once anything was drawn.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposits `assets` into the vault and receives shares at the current NAV, at least
`min_shares_out`. The first deposit locks `DEAD_SHARES` in the pool.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The asset's token program.

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The share mint's token program.

instructions.name: draw
docs: Draws a tranche of `amount` from the vault to the borrower while the draw window is open,
against the signed pagaré whose hash is `document_hash`. The borrower and the attestor
sign. Interest on the tranche, at the annual rate to the last due date, is fixed here.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: The pool's attestor (D14): the agreements engine attests that the pagaré behind
`document_hash` was signed by the borrower and is conserved. No money moves without it.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the pagaré asset and its sidecar: the app's relayer, since SME wallets
rarely hold SOL. Any signer.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset that is the pagaré, created by the Core program in this
instruction at a program-derived address, so clients need no keypair for it.

accounts.name: pagare
docs: The program's record of the pagaré.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' collection the pool controls (validated at `init_pool`).

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Creates the pool, its vault and its dead-shares account around `asset_mint` and the
admin-supplied share mint, with the grace period (seconds) that applies to every line of
the pool, the largest line `open_line` accepts as a share of the NAV in basis points
(`1..=10_000`), and the attestor (the agreements engine's key).

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022; `token_program` must be the mint's own program.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The share mint, created by the admin beforehand and validated here (series-shelf 2c):
mint authority = this pool's PDA, supply 0, the asset's decimals, and no extension that
takes or hides value. `DefaultAccountState = Frozen` makes the shares permissioned.

accounts.name: vault
docs: A PDA token account, so nobody can pre-create it and block the pool.

accounts.name: dead_shares
docs: Holds the dead shares of the first deposit; nothing ever moves them. On a permissioned
share mint it is born frozen and must be thawed by the mint's freeze authority before the
first deposit (in this transaction or a later one).

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection the pagaré assets are minted into: created by the
admin beforehand with the pool PDA as update authority, validated in the handler
(`validate_collection`), like the share mint.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token program of `asset_mint` (classic SPL Token or Token-2022).

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The token program of `share_mint` (Token-2022 in production, under Token ACL).

instructions.name: mark_in_collection
docs: Moves a scheduled line to collection once `max_missed` installments are missed and the
grace period of the last of them has run. Anyone may call it, also while paused.

instructions.name: open_line
docs: Approves credit line `line_id` (the next in sequence): a commitment of `principal` to
`borrower` at an annual `rate_bps`, drawable in tranches until the first due date (or the
term on a bullet line). The admin, the borrower, the attestor and a named sponsor sign.
With `schedule`, the line is repaid in installments on the contract's calendar; without
it, at `term_end`. Moves no money.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: The sponsor named in the arguments; required (and signing) when one is named.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: The pool's attestor (D16): the agreements engine attests that the signed agreement behind
`agreement_hash` exists and matches the arguments.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for the NAV the concentration cap is measured against.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burns `shares` and receives assets at the current NAV, at least `min_assets_out`, up to
the vault's liquidity.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The asset's token program.

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The share mint's token program.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Repays up to `amount` of a drawn line: late interest (which `amount` must cover), then
interest, then principal, and never more than is due. Anyone may pay. A full repayment
closes the line and forfeits the undrawn remainder.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may repay: the borrower, a sponsor paying the interest, or a third party.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Read for the share supply (`NavUpdated` and the invariant check).

instructions.name: set_attestor
docs: Replaces the pool's attestor. Admin only; the recovery when the agreements engine's key
rotates or is lost.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pauses or resumes deposits, redemptions, openings and draws. Repayments, collection and
write-offs are never paused.

instructions.name: suspend_draws
docs: Closes the draw window of an approved or active line now (a KYC failure, a default
event). Admin only. Repayment is untouched; it is not a pause.

instructions.name: write_off
docs: Recognises the unpaid principal of a line as a loss. Admin only. Allowed on an active line
once `now > term_end + grace`, and on a line in collection once its oldest missed
installment is more than `grace` past due (or the term is). It does not wait: the call
books the loss the moment one of those conditions holds.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Read for the share supply (`NavUpdated` and the invariant check).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for the NAV in the event.

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: The pool is paused

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the pool admin may do this

errors.name: WrongAmount
errors.msg: Amount is zero or exceeds what is due

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Not enough liquidity in the vault

errors.name: LineStatus
errors.msg: The line is not in the required status

errors.name: TermNotEnded
errors.msg: The term has not ended

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: SponsorRequired
errors.msg: The sponsor named on this line must sign

errors.name: ZeroShares
errors.msg: The deposit would mint zero shares

errors.name: FirstDepositTooSmall
errors.msg: First deposit below the minimum

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: Wrong mint or token account

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: The result is below the minimum the caller accepts

errors.name: TermEnded
errors.msg: The term has ended

errors.name: InvalidSchedule
errors.msg: The installment schedule is not valid

errors.name: ScheduleEndsAfterTerm
errors.msg: The last installment would fall due after the term

errors.name: NotScheduled
errors.msg: The line has no installment schedule

errors.name: NotEnoughMissed
errors.msg: Fewer installments missed than the line allows before collection

errors.name: LateInterestUnpaid
errors.msg: The repayment must cover the late interest due

errors.name: WriteOffTooEarly
errors.msg: A line in collection is written off only after its oldest missed due date plus grace, or after the term plus grace

errors.name: BorrowerIsAdmin
errors.msg: The pool admin cannot be the borrower

errors.name: LineTooLarge
errors.msg: The principal exceeds the pool's maximum line, max_line_bps of the NAV

errors.name: InvariantBroken
errors.msg: A pool invariant does not hold after this instruction; the transaction is refused

errors.name: AssetMintNotAllowed
errors.msg: The asset mint carries a Token-2022 extension the pool does not accept

errors.name: ShareMintNotAllowed
errors.msg: The share mint is not one this pool can own and price: wrong authority, supply, decimals or extensions

errors.name: AttestorRequired
errors.msg: The pool's attestor must sign

errors.name: AvailabilityEnded
errors.msg: The draw window of this line has closed

errors.name: TooManyDraws
errors.msg: The line has reached its maximum number of draws

errors.name: CollectionNotAllowed
errors.msg: The collection is not a Metaplex Core collection whose update authority is the pool

errors.name: DocumentHashRequired
errors.msg: The signed pagaré's hash is required

types.name: AttestorSet
docs: The pool's attestor, at `init_pool` and after every `set_attestor`.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: A public program that co-signed the opening; `None` for a commercial line.

fields.name: agreement_hash
docs: Hash of the signed credit agreement.

fields.name: principal
docs: The approved commitment; `available = principal - drawn`.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Annual ordinary interest rate, in basis points, charged on each tranche from its draw to
the last due date (decision 9).

fields.name: interest_due
docs: Ordinary interest charged so far: the sum over tranches of
`amount * rate_bps * (last_due - drawn) / (BPS * SECONDS_PER_YEAR)`, each fixed at its
draw. Zero at opening; it changes only at a draw.

fields.name: drawn_at
docs: Time of the first draw; informational since decision 25 (the calendar is `first_due_at`).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zero on a bullet line (single maturity). On a scheduled line, the installment schedule,
read and written only through [`CreditLine::schedule`] and [`CreditLine::set_schedule`]:
| bytes  | field              | type    | meaning                                         |
| 0..8   | `interval_seconds` | i64 LE  | seconds between due dates, from `drawn_at`      |
| 8..10  | `installments`     | u16 LE  | number of installments, 1..=`MAX_INSTALLMENTS`  |
| 10..12 | `late_bps`         | u16 LE  | annual late interest rate on overdue amounts    |
| 12     | `max_missed`       | u8      | missed installments that allow collection       |
| 13     | `flags`            | u8      | reserved, zero                                  |
| 14..22 | `late_collected`   | u64 LE  | late interest collected so far                  |
| 22..30 | `late_paid_until`  | i64 LE  | late interest is settled up to this time        |
| 30..32 | unused             | zero    |                                                 |

fields.name: drawn
docs: Principal transferred to the borrower so far; `drawn <= principal`, never decreases.

fields.name: draws
docs: Number of tranches drawn; at most `MAX_DRAWS`.

fields.name: availability_end
docs: Last instant a draw is accepted (strict `<`): `first_due_at` on a scheduled line,
`term_end` on a bullet line, fixed at opening; `suspend_draws` brings it to now.

fields.name: first_due_at
docs: The first due date, from the signed contract; installment `k` is due at
`first_due_at + (k - 1) * interval`. Zero on a bullet line.

fields.name: sponsor_role
docs: `SPONSOR_PROMOTER` or `SPONSOR_GUARANTOR`; meaningful only when `sponsor` is named.

fields.name: expediente_root
docs: Salted merkle root of the credit file in the agreements engine (decision 15 of the pagaré
design). A commitment: no document, name or folio is derivable from it.

types.name: LateInterestCollected
docs: Late interest collected by a repayment of a scheduled line; it stays in the pool and raises
the NAV like interest. Emitted before the `LineRepaid` of the same repayment.

types.name: LineCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_line` (decision 25): an approved commitment nobody drew is cleared.

types.name: LineDrawState
docs: Emitted by `draw` after `LineDrawn`: the line after the tranche and the hash of the signed
pagaré of this disposición (D9, decision 13). The hash is not stored on the line.

types.name: LineDrawn
docs: One tranche. Since line v3 `amount` is the tranche, not the whole principal, and `draw`
emits it once per tranche, so indexers that sum it keep working.

types.name: LineDrawsSuspended
docs: Emitted by `suspend_draws` (D10): the admin closed the draw window early; `available_forfeited`
is the undrawn remainder that can no longer be drawn. Repayment is untouched.

types.name: LineInCollection
docs: A scheduled line moved to collection. `remaining` is the principal and interest still due,
without late interest.

types.name: LineScheduled
docs: Emitted by `open_line` after `LineOpened` when the line has an installment schedule.

types.name: LineSponsorRole
docs: Emitted by `open_line` after `LineTermsSet`: which kind of promise the sponsor made
(decision 19, D12). `role` is `SPONSOR_PROMOTER` or `SPONSOR_GUARANTOR`; emitted with
`sponsor == None` and role 0 when no sponsor is named.

types.name: LineTermsSet
docs: Emitted by `open_line` after `LineOpened` (and `LineScheduled`): the facts of a version-3
opening that the earlier events cannot carry. `first_due_at` is zero on a bullet line.

types.name: NavUpdated
docs: The NAV and the share supply after every instruction that moves either (`deposit`,
`redeem`, `repay`, `write_off`), read back after the CPIs. For indexers, the shelf page and a
later secondary venue: `price per share = total_assets / share_supply`.

types.name: Pagare
docs: The program's own record of one pagaré (decision 24, pagaré design): the sidecar of the
Metaplex Core asset `draw` mints for a disposición. It holds no status and no folio: a
pagaré's state is derived from the line (covered oldest first by `draw_index`), and the
agreements engine maps the index to its folio off chain. `cancel_pagare` (step 6c) will close
it and return its rent to the relayer; until then the rent of every draw stays locked.

fields.name: draw_index
docs: Which disposición of the line, 0-based: the `draws` count at the time of the draw.

fields.name: asset
docs: The Core asset at `[PAGARE_ASSET, line, draw_index]`.

fields.name: pagare_hash
docs: Hash of the signed pagaré data message, as `draw` received it.

fields.name: amount
docs: The tranche this pagaré documents.

fields.name: due_at
docs: The line's last due date at issuance (D1): when the last payment is owed.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for later facts (an endoso count, the current holder) without a layout change.

types.name: PagareIssued
docs: Emitted by `draw` after `LineDrawState` (decision 24): the pagaré of this disposición was
issued as the Metaplex Core asset `asset`, held frozen by `holder` (the pool PDA, the series
vehicle's custody account). `due_at` is the line's last due date at issuance.

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA token account `[VAULT, pool]` for `asset_mint`, owned by the pool PDA.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The share token mint; its mint authority is the pool PDA.

fields.name: dead_shares
docs: PDA share token account `[DEAD, pool]`, owned by the pool PDA; never burned.

fields.name: outstanding_principal
docs: Principal drawn and neither repaid nor written off.

fields.name: interest_collected
docs: Informative running total.

fields.name: written_off
docs: Informative running total.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Pool parameters packed into spare bytes, so the account layout does not change:
| bytes   | field                  | type     | meaning                                   |
| 0..4    | `grace_period_seconds` | u32 LE   | grace after a due date; zero means none   |
| 4..6    | `max_line_bps`         | u16 LE   | largest line as a share of the NAV, in bps |
| 6       | `permissioned`         | u8 flag  | 1: shares are frozen by default (Token ACL) |
| 7       | `asset_controls`       | u8 bits  | bit 0: asset freeze authority; bit 1: Pausable |
| 8..32   | unused                 | zero     |                                           |
Read and written only through the accessors below (`grace_period_seconds`,
`max_line_bps`, `permissioned`, `asset_controls` and their setters).

fields.name: attestor
docs: The agreements engine's key. It co-signs `open_line`, `draw` and `endorse_pagare`,
attesting that the signed document behind the hash exists and matches the arguments.
Rotated by the admin with `set_attestor`; never the zero key.

fields.name: collection
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection, in which `draw` mints one pagaré asset per
disposición. Recorded at `init_pool`; validated as a Core collection from step 6 of the
pool v2 batch.

types.name: PoolCollectionSet
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection the pool records, at `init_pool`.

types.name: PoolConfigured
docs: Emitted by `init_pool` after `PoolInitialized`: the pool parameters fixed at launch.

types.name: PoolFlags
docs: Emitted by `init_pool` after `PoolLineCapSet`: the read-only facts about the two mints.
`asset_controls`: the issuer controls on the asset mint, as `Pool::asset_controls` bits
(bit 0 freeze authority, bit 1 Pausable). `permissioned`: the share mint is frozen by
default, so holders must be thawed (Token ACL).

types.name: PoolLineCapSet
docs: Emitted by `init_pool` after `PoolConfigured` (a new event, since events are append-only):
the concentration cap, the largest line as a share of the NAV in basis points.

types.name: ScheduleParams
docs: Installment terms requested by `open_line`; fixed for the life of the line.

fields.name: first_due_at
docs: The first due date (unix seconds), from the signed contract; must be after the opening.

fields.name: interval_seconds
docs: Seconds between due dates; installment `k` is due at `first_due_at + (k - 1) * interval_seconds`.

fields.name: installments
docs: `drawn + interest_due` is paid in this many installments.

fields.name: late_bps
docs: Annual late interest rate on overdue amounts, in basis points.

fields.name: max_missed
docs: Missed installments after which anyone may move the line to collection.
